name: add_shortlink_link_labels
description: Repo-scale: add a validated labels array to links (model + new labelService + store + route), with a composable ?label= filter on GET /links
prompts: Add labels to links. Link gains a `labels: string[]` field. Validate each label with a new src/services/labelService.ts exporting `isValidLabel` (same shape as slugService's isValidSlug: lowercase alphanumeric groups joined by single hyphens, 1-20 chars) - POST /links must reject with 400 `{ error: "invalid label" }` if any provided label fails validation, and default to an empty array when `labels` is omitted entirely. Add an optional `?label=` query parameter to GET /links that returns only links containing that exact label, without breaking the existing unfiltered listing when no label query param is given.
